desc: The OMEN Recon 3.0 follows the lineage of the Watchman, offering 300 WM performance in a shorter, more maneuverable package. There is no sacrifice in accuracy, only slightly lower velocities as compared to the Watchman. With an 18" steel barrel sculpted from a Bartlein blank, and chambered in-house the RECON possesses effectiveness out to 1200 yards and beyond, making it ideal for applications from long range precision to hunting. Additional features include a 15" 6061 M-LOK modular rail, NEMO dual chamber compact muzzle brake, 4 position adjustable gas system for suppressed and un-suppressed use, Titanium takedown and pivot pins, Ambidextrous safety selector, Geissele SSA-E two stage trigger, Magpul MIAD grip, Magpul PRS adjustable rifle stock, recoil reducing bolt carrier and nickel boron coated bolt. There is no other carbine on the planet like the OMEN RECON.
